Cryptographic hash algorithms such as MD2, MD4, MD5, MD6, HAVAL-128, HMAC-MD5, DSA (which uses SHA-1) are no longer considered secure.

MessageDigest md1 = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA");  // Sensitive

Ask Yourself Whether

The hashed value is used in a security context like:

  • User-password storage.
  • Security token generation (used to confirm e-mail when registering on a website, reset password, etc …​).

There is a risk if you answered yes to any of those questions.

Recommended Secure Coding Practices

Safer alternatives, such as SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-3 are recommended.

See

  • OWASP - Top 10 2021 Category A2 - Cryptographic Failures
  • CWE - CWE-1240 - Use of a Risky Cryptographic Primitive
